task_anchors.task_description: Assessing physical fire damage and forming an initial diagnostic read of ventilation-limited burning conditions
Choosing excavation sequence between two proximate candidate ignition sources under safety and documentation constraints
Gathering and evaluating conflicting witness statements against a dispatch log
Selecting a single component for costly, irreversible forensic lab retention under budget and demolition deadline pressure
Composing a final written report classification balancing competing hypotheses under reporting deadline
